summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of SANCTUM MARMORIS (Brutalismo Sacro). All 16 review items verified as working on the public preview URL. Hero, WebGL canvas, navigation, marquee, catalog (4 items), detail modal, contact form (validation + success), footer, and cursor are all functional. No console errors blocking the experience.
critical_code_review_comments:
Hero title

markup uses piedra
guarda el silencio
de lo eterno. Title rendered correctly but text-content concatenates without spaces between lines (cosmetic only, browser shows
properly).
Contact form uses localStorage as MOCKED persistence (frontend-only, expected per spec).
Nav uses buttons/divs not <a> tags but the 4 visible labels (INICIO, CATÁLOGO, MANIFIESTO, ENCARGO) plus Encargar CTA are all rendered correctly per screenshot.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend-only React + R3F app. Public URL https://faith-gallery-8.preview.emergentagent.com. DISABLE_VISUAL_EDITS=true must remain to prevent x-line-number Babel injections breaking R3F. Contact form persists to localStorage key 'sm_orders' (MOCKED). All data-testid attributes confirmed present: app-root, hero-title, hero-cta-explorar, webgl-canvas, main-nav, marquee, catalog-item-{id} for 4 items, detail-overlay, detail-close, detail-cta-encargar, section-contact, section-manifest, contact-form, contact-input-{name|email|interest|message}, contact-submit. Verified flows: empty submit→error toast 'Completa todos los campos requeridos.', valid submit→success toast 'Solicitud enviada. Te responderemos en 48 horas.' and form clears. Modal CTA 'Solicitar esta obra' closes modal and scrolls to #contact. Footer contains 'SANCTUM MARMORIS'. Hero font-family resolves to 'Marcellus, serif'. Cursor dot+ring elements rendered.
